subscriptions.name: board-wake
subscriptions.description: A task of a granted project became READY, or a task the team has an attempt for changed state, and aicrew did not make the change itself: the team's coordinators are woken.

subscriptions.name: forge-wake
subscriptions.description: A change of an attempt's pull request that a member acts on: the worker is woken always, the coordinators when it bears on a submit.
